description: Given a sha256 digest of a file, container layer or package, find every Sigstore transparency-log entry that signed it — the answer to "was this artifact ever signed, and by whom". Also searches by the email identity on a keyless signing certificate. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for software supply-chain provenance: a package registry only knows what it serves today, this is the immutable public record of the signing event. Returns entry uuids for rekor_entry. Keyless. Example: rekor_search_by_hash({ hash: "34358ac1970360f3a44218b2cbd2c2a615500af25e8a3e467295d6ee18658d1f" }).

email.description: Email identity on the signing certificate, e.g. a CI service account address.

hash.description: sha256 digest of the artifact, as 64 hex characters or "sha256:<hex>".

name: rekor_search_by_hash
title: Rekor Search By Hash
